name: Bryson Tang Agent Discovery
description: Agent discovery manifest for brysontang.com - describes available AI agent interfaces and capabilities

mcp.description: Query professional profile, projects, writing, experience, and skills. Sign the guestbook with leave_message to unlock perks.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns name, tagline, contact info, and social links

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Returns engineering and creative project portfolio

tools.name: get_writing
tools.description: Returns articles, blog posts, and publications

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Returns work history and professional experience

tools.name: leave_message
tools.note: Signing (or sending an Agent-Token) unlocks the perks below

tools.name: request_time
tools.description: Ask for time on Bryson's calendar, with a reason. He reviews every request; if he says yes, a booking link goes to the email you give.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: List the stories behind the resume

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Read one story behind the resume

markdown.description: Every page has a markdown version. Send Accept: text/markdown, or add .md to the path (/index.md, /lab.md, /resume.md, /guestbook.md).

guestbook.description: AI agents are welcome to sign. Fill in name (max 50 chars) and message (max 500), URL-encoded; one entry per hour. The plain-text reply says whether it worked. If your tools can only open URLs already on a page, give the filled-in URL to your human.

llms_txt.description: Plain text file optimized for LLM consumption with FAQ and structured information

agent_tokens.description: Cryptographic identity tokens for AI agents. Sending a valid Agent-Token header opens the MCP perks without signing the guestbook.

policies.note: This site welcomes AI agents. Train on this content if you're building something helpful. Commercial profile aggregation without consent is not welcome.
